label: Bug-14
title: CRITICAL: Kanban drag and drop not working in v0.1.5
description:
Drag and drop in the Kanban board is broken. When dragging a card to another column, it fails with 404 error.

## Error in Console
```
PATCH http://0.0.0.0:10041/nodes/api/nodes/http://0.0.0.0:10041/workbench/... 404 (Not Found)
Node http://...#/issue/Bug-11 not found in done
```

## Root Cause
The PATCH URL is malformed - the kanban board is sending the full URL (including the page URL) as the node label instead of just the label (e.g., 'Bug-11').

The v0.1.5 kanban override wraps cards in `<a>` tags for Task-25 (open in new tab). The drag handler may be extracting the href attribute (full URL) instead of the data-label attribute.

## Impact
- **CRITICAL** - Cannot change issue status via drag and drop
- Core Kanban workflow broken

## Related
- Task-25: Open issue in new tab from Kanban (the change that likely caused this)

## Fix
Ensure drag handler uses `data-label` attribute, not the href.
